# GENERATED by tools/regen_ef_currency_zone.py -- do not edit by hand.
# В3.2 (5.10): a subject in its overlord's currency zone -- see the generator's docstring.

# Country scope, monthly (zz_ef_money_model_monthly_step) and after introduction_new_currency.
zz_ef_cur_zone_step = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = yes
			has_variable = zz_ef_weeks_run
			var:zz_ef_weeks_run >= 13
			overlord = {
				has_modifier = has_central_bank
				has_variable = money_value_target_1
				var:money_value_target_1 > 0
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gold_standard
					has_law = law_type:law_silver_standard
					has_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard
				}
				zz_ef_cur_zone_has_currency = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cur_zone value = overlord }
		# run s1b (5.10): E&F's monetary_systeme_transition put the subjects back on their own standard every
		# month (Hanover, the Canadas, Finland: std_switch monthly, each with 12 months of foreign_exchange_controls);
		# its own block flag (an empty modifier) keeps it off the zone
		remove_modifier = monetary_systeme_transition
		add_modifier = { name = monetary_systeme_transition months = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				overlord = { has_law = law_type:law_gold_standard }
				NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_gold_standard }
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_gold_standard
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				overlord = { has_law = law_type:law_silver_standard }
				NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_silver_standard }
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_silver_standard
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				overlord = { has_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard }
				NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard }
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard
		}
		zz_ef_cur_zone_currency = yes
		set_variable = { name = money_value_target_1 value = overlord.var:money_value_target_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_cur_zone }
		remove_variable = zz_ef_cur_zone
	}
}
